newsitem.title: USA: Central Garden files for 5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Central Garden files for 5 mln shares.

text.p: Central Garden & Pet Company filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to five million common shares.
The company will sell 4.79 million common shares and a group of shareholders will sell 210,000 shares, according to the SEC filing.
Underwriters for the offering, Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Hambrecht & Quist, Merrill Lynch & Co and Wasserstein Perella Securities, have an over-allotment option of up to 750,000 shares.
The Lafayette, Calif., distributor of garden and pet supply products said proceeds from the sale will be used to refinance outstanding debt and to fund future acquisitions.
After the offering, the company will have 18,323,182 common shares outstanding and 1,663,167 Class B shares outstanding.
